title: Paloma Rewards Discount on the Cash Pickup Reactivation Fee
content:
**Paloma Rewards benefit.** Members receive a discount on the fee for reactivating an expired Cash Pickup pickup. It follows the tier of the sender's Paloma Rewards membership whose status is active.

| Sender's active Paloma Rewards tier | Discount taken off the reactivation fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| Paloma Rewards Gold, Paloma Rewards Platinum, Paloma Rewards Diamond or Paloma Rewards Elite | 1.00 |
| Paloma Rewards Blue or Paloma Rewards Silver | 0.50 |
| no active membership | nothing |

**How it is taken off.** The discount is taken off the reactivation fee as a whole, meaning the tier's fee together with anything added to it. The fee never falls below zero, and the result is rounded half up to the cent.

## Examples (hypothetical fees as a whole)

| Fee as a whole | Member | Fee after discount |
|---|---|---|
| 4.99 | active Gold | 3.99 |
| 4.99 | active Silver | 4.49 |
| 0.40 | active Elite | 0.00, never below zero |
| 4.99 | membership not active | 4.99 |
